text:
Alex P.: Morning team — I'm on primary for the 06:00-14:00 PT shift today. I'm going to pair with Lia for the first hour for shadowing (new on-call onboarding). Quick plan: I'll handle paging and mitigations, Lia will observe and ask questions. :wave:

OpsBot: Incident alert (sev3) routed to #eng-oncall at 06:12 — redis-error spikes. Paging @Alex P..

Alex P.: reading the incident now. Looks like increased 5xx from redis caches in eu-west. Checking runbook -> link: https://internal.docs/runbooks/redis_cache_incident (read-only for shadow)

Lia Chen: noted. Should I take notes in the runbook checklist? happy to do postmortem drafts.

Alex P.: yes please. Under the runbook there's a "What I tried" section — add commands you see. Also watch me do the hotfix so you can ask clarifying Qs.

Samir: ping — if this escalates to sev2, remember to also notify on-call-sre and paging-policy says escalate at 15m if errors > 5% 

Tia Nguyen: Lia — when you shadow, remind them to check the caching layer TTLs and the prefix eviction metrics. We had a similar thing last month.

Alex P.: doing `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=redis-proxy --since=10m | grep ERR` to find noisy clients. If we see obvious client retry storm we'll add a 429 filter (quick mitig).

Jordan L.: FYI — if you need a temporary capacity bump, the Dedicated pool autoscale can add 1 GPU for <10min, but needs owner approval. Ops on-call has the approval token.

Alex P.: mitigation applied: rate-limit rule added to proxy (rule id r-2026-temp). Error rate dropped from 6.2% -> 1.1% in 7m. Lia, can you write the snippet I ran into the runbook?

Lia Chen: added snippet and timestamps. Also added a note about who to loop in for capacity: `@Jordan L.`. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Note: handoff reminder in 30m for Alex -> Samir shift. Please post PRE-HANDOFF summary 10m before handoff.

Alex P.: Good call. I'll post a 1-paragraph pre-handoff summary 10m before 14:00 PT with open actions, still-open alerts, and who has keys. Lia — can you stay for the handoff? it's useful for your onboarding.

Lia Chen: I can. Also quick question — for new on-call folks we usually run through the escalation tree and the CLI shortcuts. Can we add a 20m onboarding checklist to the shift?

Samir: +1 to checklist. Suggestion for onboarding checklist items: 1) How to read incident bot alerts, 2) How to find the last 3 deploys (deploy-bot link), 3) Where to find contact for infra (pager duty + infra slack), 4) Runbook edit etiquette and postmortem stub.

Tia Nguyen: I'll attach a compact cheat sheet to the runbook with those links. Lia, when you shadow, try the recovery steps yourself while Alex talks through them. Active practice helps.

Alex P.: Agree. Also note: coverage gap tonight 22:00-00:00 PT — we have reduced staff. If anything escalates to sev2 during that window, auto-escalate to the on-call SRE lead and page the backup rotation (see runbook section "after-hours backup"). Lia, we'll tag that in the onboarding doc.

Samir: Posting the handoff template here so Alex can paste: 
```
Handoff summary (1-2 lines):
Open alerts: [list]
Actions in progress: [list with owner]
Mitigations applied: [list]
Next steps: [list]
Known gaps: [list]
Links: [runbook link, dashboards, deploys]
```

Alex P.: Copying that into the pre-handoff. Final note for new folks: if you ever feel unsure, call out loudly in the channel and tag @OpsBot escalate, don't try to handle silently. Better to get eyes early. :thumbsup:

Lia Chen: Thanks — feeling better about the flow. Staying on for handoff and the 20m onboard checklist.

Jordan L.: If you need a walkthrough of the autoscale token flow after the shift, ping me. I can record a quick 5m clip for the runbook.

Alex P.: Thanks everyone. Will post pre-handoff at ~13:50 PT. Lia — you'll lead the post-incident notes.
